name: Native Trainer
author: Skate Rust Engine
description: Live native gameplay tuning. All values are multipliers of the current stock difficulty/surface. Disable to restore stock. Editable from the left Escape panel.

pop.label: Pop height
pop.description: Multiplies native ground-jump minimum and maximum heights. 1.00x is stock.

grind_pop.label: Grind pop height
grind_pop.description: Multiplies the existing grind-launch height. 1.00x is stock.

push_speed.label: Maximum push speed
push_speed.description: Multiplies the speed up to which pushing works. This is not a downhill speed cap. 1.00x is stock.

push_power.label: Push power
push_power.description: Multiplies native difficulty-specific push velocity changes. 1.00x is stock.

braking.label: Brake strength
braking.description: Multiplies foot and tail braking forces. 1.00x is stock.

steering.label: Steering response
steering.description: Multiplies the native general steering scalar. 1.00x is stock.

wobble.label: Speed wobble
wobble.description: Multiplies native wobble amplitude. Zero removes wobble. 1.00x is stock.
